opportunity.title: Jury Management Solution (JMS) System (Presolicitation)
opportunity.agency: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts
opportunity.description: Pre-solicitation notice for a web-based Jury Management System for the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts. The solicitation is unrestricted and not set aside for small business; the Judiciary is not subject to the FAR small business regulations. The AO plans a single-award IDIQ for a commercial off-the-shelf web-based jury management solution that supports selecting, managing and tracking jurors, performs financial and statistical calculations, and interfaces with the Judiciary's financial management system, Momentum. The draft solicitation USCA27R0009 gives requirements and evaluation criteria. The due time is listed as TBD.

supportedClaims.text: The Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts issued a presolicitation notice for a Jury Management Solution (JMS) System seeking a single-award IDIQ contract for a COTS web-based solution.
The AO is conducting market research via an RFI to gather industry feedback for a modernized Jury Management System.

The AO plans to award a single IDIQ contract for a COTS, web-based JMS that will perform juror selection, management, tracking, financial/statistical calculations and integrate with the Momentum financial system.
Responses to the RFP USCA24R0030 – Web-Based JMS are due by 12:00 PM ET on Friday, May 31, 2024, and must be emailed to the specified contracting officers.
Tyler Technologies offers a comprehensive web-based jury management system used in courts across 30 U.S. states and Canada, representing a potential competitor.
Catalis provides a modern jury management solution with secure, intuitive tools for U.S. courts, another possible competitor.
